summary.intent: Run an autonomous overnight session (10:35 PM to 8 AM) using specialist agent teams to fix all test failures, implement the EVO/Mycelium closed-loop autoresearch system, build a compound engineering analytics subsystem, and continuously brainstorm and execute improvements to Cohezion.
summary.outcome: Achieved ~1865+ passing tests (up from ~1600), shipped the Mycelium additive-calibration fix (E57, proven via E55-E62), built 10+ compound analytics modules (ExperimentAnalytics, ExperimentScheduler, HealthMonitor, LoopVisualizer, CompoundEngine, etc.), fixed FLUME VAE dual-mode architecture (3→4-value forward return), and committed multiple batches of surgical improvements despite persistent Entire.io checkpoint reversion issues.

repo: autoresearch.jsonl is tracked by LFS but is a runtime log — it caused persistent pre-commit stash/restore failures. Fixed by git rm --cached + .gitignore.
The Entire.io checkpoint daemon periodically resets the working tree to its orphan-branch snapshot. Workaround: git checkout HEAD -- <file> to restore, or develop a restore script.
KAGGLE_GUARD_DISABLE=1 env var is required for commits that touch any files under scripts/nemotron_autoresearch.py or src/cohezion/competition/nemotron_solver/.
psutil resource guardrails fire on busy machines (CPU 99.4%) and block CompoundExecutor tests. tests/compound/conftest.py must mock BOTH psutil.virtual_memory AND psutil.cpu_percent.

QuadratureNexus._score_adjustments[vt] is OVERWRITTEN on every run_llm_deliberation() call — must use _mycelium_calibration for persistent cross-cycle Mycelium state (the E57 additive-calibration fix).
autoresearch.jsonl record format: experiment label is at r['asi']['experiment'] not r['experiment']; status is r['status'] not r['verdict']; primary metric is r['metric'] not r['delta'].
log_result() signature has 6 positional args: (run, metric, metrics, status, description, experiment, **extra) — missing run and status is a silent failure that produces wrong JSONL records.
Lemonade iGPU ROCm stack enters a silent failure mode where all evaluation prompts return empty strings but arithmetic works; detect via a '2+2=' probe before enabling LLM mode.
OllamaEmbeddingProvider was removed from src/cohezion/flume/vae_encoder.py — any test that patches 'cohezion.flume.vae_encoder.OllamaEmbeddingProvider' will fail at fixture setup, not assertion time.

code.finding: FlumeVAE.forward() now returns 4 values (recon/logits, mu, log_var, z) consistently. Added legacy MLP mode via FlumeVAE(input_dim=768, latent_dim=256). reparameterize() returns mu deterministically in eval mode. flume_vae_loss() added as standalone module-level function supporting both float (MSE) and token (cross-entropy) reconstruction.

Was unpacking 4 values from model() when forward() returned 3. Fixed to unpack (recon, mu, logvar, _z) after adding z back to forward return. Reconstruction cosine similarity now handles 3D logit tensors via argmax.

apply_mycelium_feedback() was using SET semantics (_score_adjustments[vt] = adjustment), causing each cycle to replace the previous adjustment with a smaller value (decaying, not compounding). Fixed to use additive accumulation: _mycelium_calibration[vt] += adjustment; _score_adjustments[vt] = _mycelium_calibration[vt]. Added oscillation detection: if last 3 calibration history entries alternate sign, halve learning rate.

Called async vault_find_relevant_context() from synchronous select_skills() without await, creating an unawaited coroutine RuntimeWarning. Fixed by routing through vault_search() sync wrapper instead.

Multiple self.mcp.vault_write(), vault_delete(), vault_read() calls in sync context. All replaced with _sync variants (vault_write_sync, vault_delete_sync, vault_read_sync) to eliminate RuntimeWarnings.

UCB1 sorting for beam exploration excluded perfect-score candidates when many untested transforms (trials=0 → UCB1=∞) filled the beam before the best-known candidate. Fixed by tracking actual best by score BEFORE UCB1 narrowing: actual_best = max(candidates, key=lambda x: x[1]).

Added vault_delete(), vault_log_decision(), vault_find_relevant_context(), vault_edit() async methods. Added vault_write_sync(), vault_read_sync(), vault_delete_sync(), vault_search(), vault_search_by_operation() synchronous wrappers using loop detection (asyncio.get_running_loop() → create_task or asyncio.run). Fixed _call_tool() error extraction to handle dict errors: err.get('message', str(err)) if isinstance(err, dict) else str(err).

Added autouse fixture _mock_psutil_resources() patching BOTH psutil.virtual_memory (percent=50.0, total=128GiB) AND psutil.cpu_percent (return 25.0). Mocking only memory was insufficient — CPU at 99.4% on the busy machine was triggering the resource guardrail independently.

test_flume_paraphrases_closer_than_unrelated was flaky because the shared advancing RNG in the mock produced accidentally anti-correlated vectors. Fixed with deterministic category-keyed mock vectors: deploy-related text → first 128 dims, test-related → last 128 dims.

Added compound_score: float = 0.0 to ExecutionResult dataclass. compound_score = 0.6*coherence + 0.3*success + 0.1*efficiency, computed just before return in execute_task(). Captures holistic execution quality in a single [0,1] metric.

Status classification was always using 'improvement' when metric_val > baseline, even for minimize-direction experiments where lower is better. Fixed with direction-aware comparison: if self.direction == 'minimize': status = 'improvement' if metric_val < self._baseline. Also fixed _update_tree() to accept both string and ExperimentOutcome for the hypothesis arg.

Added HIHO_THRESHOLD=0.5 class constant, _logged_opportunity_hashes set for dedup, and generate_next_experiments(n, session_metrics, retired_labels) async method. HIHO balance determines mode: coherence >= 0.5 → 'exploit' (tune params), below → 'explore' (new hypotheses). Retired experiments get replacement proposals first.

workflow: Surgical git add pattern is essential: ruff format + ruff check --fix manually before staging, then git add <specific_files> only (never git add -A), to avoid staging runtime files, LFS conflicts, or Kaggle guard triggers.

When AsyncClient is the production class, tests must patch 'cohezion.core.mcp_client.httpx.AsyncClient' not 'httpx.Client'. All methods on AsyncClient need AsyncMock (Python 3.8+) — MagicMock().method() is not awaitable.
FastMCP SSE response format requires {"type": "text", "text": "..."} in content items — omitting 'type' silently falls through to the wrong return branch in _call_tool().
For unittest.TestCase with async production code: asyncio.run(client.method()) is the correct pattern. pytest-asyncio async def test_* is not compatible with unittest.TestCase.

Pre-commit stash/restore fails when the working tree has many unstaged files (LFS conflicts, untracked files). git stash push --keep-index + manual mv of the conflicting file is the reliable workaround.

The compound engineering analytics subsystem (experiment_analytics, experiment_scheduler, loop_visualizer, compound_engine, etc.) enables live HIHO balance tracking, retirement candidate detection, and next-experiment recommendations from autoresearch.jsonl data.

Convergence formula for Mycelium compounding: consensus_n = threshold - gap_0 * (1 - lr/2)^n. At lr=2.0 it crosses the 0.85 threshold in one cycle. At lr=1.0 it asymptotically approaches 0.85 over ~5 cycles.

V-model structural invariant tests using inspect.signature() run ~1ms each and catch refactor drift (renamed params, changed defaults, removed fields) before behavioral tests. File: tests/compound/test_executor_vmodel_structural.py.

friction: Entire.io checkpoint daemon repeatedly reverted working tree edits by resetting to its orphan branch snapshot — required git checkout HEAD -- <file> restores after every context compaction.
autoresearch.jsonl LFS pointer/content mismatch blocked every commit attempt until untracked via git rm --cached + .gitignore.
Pre-commit stash/restore phase failed due to large number of background unstaged/untracked files, requiring manual mv of conflicting files before each commit.
Lemonade iGPU ROCm stack entered silent failure mode (returning empty strings for evaluation prompts but not arithmetic) — LLM mode unavailable for overnight experiments, forcing heuristic fallback.
Multiple concurrent overnight_evo_loop.py processes accumulated across restarts, competing for the event queue and doubling compute usage.
ruff-quick pre-commit hook auto-fixed lint issues in staged files, causing 'stash restore would overwrite' errors and requiring re-staging after each hook run.
FLUME CLI tests (test_flume_cli.py, test_cli_train.py) produce SIGSEGV from GPU/torch stack — unfixable without hardware context, left as known failures.
The Entire.io checkpoint daemon also committed changes made by parallel agents to separate branches, creating merge divergence that blocked simple pushes.

BioelectricNetwork API mismatch: method called percolate() in experiments but actual name is percolation_analysis(threshold); field called giant_component_fraction but actual name is largest_cluster_size.
open_items: FLUME CLI tests (test_flume_cli.py, test_cli_train.py) still failing with SIGSEGV on GPU load — hardware/driver issue requiring ROCm stack investigation, not a code bug.
28 swarm tests depend on live Ollama service — not runnable in CI without service mocking.
JEPA world model learning (E46) is flat because heuristic mode produces an identical 12D input distribution each run — genuine learning requires LLM mode where scores vary.
E71-E76 experiments were import-verified but not runtime-verified end-to-end due to the log_result signature fix happening near session end.
Lemonade iGPU ROCm recovery: when the GPU stack recovers, re-enable LLM mode and re-run E55-E62 and E71-E76 with real scores to get variance-weighted results.
Retirement criterion uses in-memory _retired set, not persisted across process restarts — E50 and E12 will be re-run after each loop restart until they accumulate 10 new keeps.
ExperimentScheduler.propose_replacements() currently uses static HIHO-balance templates — could be improved to propose experiments from failed hypotheses in autoresearch.jsonl.
SurrealDB journey_point writes for E55-E62 experiments bypass the telemetry bus (direct nexus.deliberate() calls) — those 40K+ autoresearch.jsonl entries have no corresponding SurrealDB records.
scripts/restore_compound_analytics.sh needs to be committed and added to CLAUDE.md as the standard recovery procedure after Entire.io resets.

E73 oscillation detection test (test_history_capped_at_5_entries) was passing but relied on the internal history list being capped — this invariant should be added to test_nexus_oscillation.py as a named structural check.
